Corollary
[Prescribed mean-curvature boundary estimate] 1. ch14:14.8\group ch14-boundary-gradient Source: gilbarg-trudinger:page-0357 Let $u\in C^2(\Omega )\cap C^1(\overline\Omega )$ solve (14.56) with $u=\varphi \in C^2(\overline\Omega )$ on $\partial \Omega $. If egin{equation} H'(y)\geq rac n{n-1}|H(y,\varphi (y))| \qquad (y\in \partial \Omega ), ag {14.57} \end{equation} then egin{equation} |Du|\leq C\qquad ext{on }\partial \Omega , ag {14.58} \end{equation} where $C=C(n,M,\Omega ,H_1,|\varphi |_{2;\Omega })$ and $H_1=\sup _{\Omega imes (-M,M)}(|H|+|DH|)$.
Proof

\sketch For the minimal-surface principal matrix, $\mathcal K^\pm =(n-1)H'$, while $b_\infty =\mp nH$ in the two normal directions. Thus (14.57) is (14.51); apply Corollary 14.7.

□

The estimate without control of $\Lambda $ uses the stricter assumptions egin{equation} a_0^{ij}=o(\Lambda ),\qquad b_0=o(|p|\Lambda ) \qquad (|p| o \infty ) ag {14.59} \end{equation} and egin{equation} \mathcal K^+>b_\infty (y,\varphi (y), u ),\qquad \mathcal K^->-b_\infty (y,\varphi (y),- u ). ag {14.60} \end{equation}
